page_title: CRE 0-2 NAP | Cremonese v Napoli 28/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
90+2' Noa Lang (Napoli) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90+1' Noa Lang (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Rasmus Hojlund and he is replaced by Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli).
88' Substitution. Matteo Politano did his best and is replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
86' Noa Lang (Napoli) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

86' Scott McTominay (Napoli) was close to scoring after a great solo effort and unleashed a promising shot from the edge of the penalty area. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Emil Audero showed his agility and saved this one. Napoli force a corner. They send men into the box.
85' Napoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
85' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Matteo Politano (Napoli). Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
84' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese).
82' We are about to witness a substitution. Romano Floriani (Cremonese) is replacing Matteo Bianchetti.

81' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) unleashes a beautiful mid-range volley low to the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains the same.s a beautiful mid-range volley low to the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score doesn't change.
77' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Alessio Zerbin is replaced by Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese).
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. Warren Bondo (Cremonese) for Alberto Grassi.
75' The shot by Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Emil Audero.
74' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) gets to a rebound inside the goalmouth, but even from this distance he misses the target and fails to score.
74' Scott McTominay (Napoli) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Emil Audero is alert and denies him.
73' David Neres comes off the pitch to be replaced by Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli).
69' Matteo Politano (Napoli) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Emil Audero.
68' Martin Payero (Cremonese) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.

67' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
66' The ball goes out of play and Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.

66' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
60' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese) replacing Tommaso Barbieri.
60' Substitution. Antonio Sanabria is replaced by Faris Moumbagna (Cremonese).
59' A corner kick by Napoli is thwarted by the well prepared Emil Audero (Cremonese).
58' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Napoli win a corner.
58' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
57' David Neres (Napoli) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
55' Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) forces a pass into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
53' Cremonese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' Here's the change. Eljif Elmas leaves the pitch and Noa Lang (Napoli) comes on as a substitute.
50' CHANCE! Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) fires just wide of the left post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Scott McTominay.
49' Scott McTominay (Napoli) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
46' Matteo Politano (Napoli) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Emil Audero easily deals with the threat.
46' Antonio Conte has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Miguel Gutierrez comes on the pitch for Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Maurizio Mariani had an easy-decision to make.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' 0 - 2 Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the bottom right corner of the net.
43' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes it short.
43' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Napoli earn a corner.
42' Napoli work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
42' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Napoli get a corner.
40' A clever short pass gives Scott McTominay (Napoli) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post.
39' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

38' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
35' Lovely run from Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
34' Juan Jesus (Napoli) has too much to say to the referee and receives a yellow card.
27' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Cremonese for a penalty. Play continues.
26' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle as Martin Payero (Cremonese) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
20' The resulting corner from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
17' Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) perfectly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate enough and the ball goes a few inches over the bar!
16' It seemed like Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
15' Matteo Politano (Napoli) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Cremonese are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
13' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
11' Napoli take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
4' Scott McTominay (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Emil Audero comes off his line to gather the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Napoli will have the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will officiate today.
